info.title: Approved incoming chain contract overlay
info.description: Merge reviewed overlay into next cumulative baseline. /deviations schemas describe incoming-scoped variant only; preserve unrelated production variants. Conditional gates and exact schema in incoming-approved-chain-contract.md.

parameters.name: investigationScope
parameters.description: Incoming UI must pass INCOMING_MATERIAL. Omitted scope retains production semantics, currently DEPENDENCY_NOT_READY. Existing IDs dispatch by persisted scope.

404.description: No incoming evidence in this organization

InspectionRequestCommand.description: All new requests including RETEST require an APPROVED QC specification via requireSelectable. RETEST requires approvedInvestigationId and original frozen version/hash; retired versions may continue only within existing requests. Requested quantity/package count cannot exceed receipt facts.

SamplingDetailCommand.description: Samples form 1..N allocations; quantity sum equals sampleQuantity in unitId. OTHER_APPROVED requires signed plan name/reason.

TestResultRevisionCommand.description: NUMERIC requires resultNumeric/resultUnitId and forbids resultText; TEXT requires resultText and forbids numeric/unit. INCONCLUSIVE requires reasonForChange. INVALID is produced only by approved investigation disposition. Signature binds target execution/content/predecessor.

ReviseResultCommand.description: NUMERIC requires resultNumeric/resultUnitId and forbids resultText; TEXT requires resultText and forbids numeric/unit. INCONCLUSIVE requires reasonForChange. INVALID is produced only by approved investigation disposition. Signature binds target execution/content/predecessor.

IncomingReleaseDecisionCommand.description: USER_QA is server-assigned. RELEASED requires valid approved report and closed accepted investigations; nonexempt lots cannot use INSPECTION_EXEMPT. No API caller can create SYSTEM_RULE evidence.

canonicalRecord.description: Exact immutable server-built canonical signing record; never an editable input.
